title: Metering the Plan Days of a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Election by Rate Plan
content:
The plan days are the stretch of the trip the cover of a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election is metered
over, and how they are counted follows the rate plan the trip is priced under on the Keyturn Trip Booking.

1. Where the trip is priced on the extended stay plan, the plan days are the whole weeks of the reserved
   period, each counted as 7 days and any part week counted as a whole week.
2. Where the trip is priced on the monthly plan or on the weekly plan, the plan days are the calendar days from
   the first reserved day to the last reserved day, both days included.
3. Where the trip is priced on any other plan, the plan days are the reserved hours divided by 24 and rounded
   up to a whole day, never fewer than 1.

## The three conventions as a table

| The rate plan the trip is priced under | What is counted | The unit it is counted in |
|---|---|---|
| The extended stay plan | The whole weeks of the reserved period, any part week counted as a whole week | Weeks of 7 days |
| The monthly plan, or the weekly plan | The first reserved day to the last reserved day, both included | Calendar days |
| Any other plan | The reserved hours, carried up to the next whole day and never below 1 | Whole days |

## Worked on hypothetical reservations

**A reserved period of 10 calendar days, first day to last day inclusive.** On the extended stay plan that is
one whole week and a part week, so two weeks are counted, and the plan days are 14. On the monthly plan or the
weekly plan the plan days are the 10 calendar days themselves. On any other plan the count is taken from the
reserved hours rather than from the span: a booking of 10 calendar days reserving 230 hours gives 10 whole days
once the hours are carried up to the next whole day.

**A reserved period of 7 calendar days.** On the extended stay plan that is exactly one whole week and the plan
days are 7; on the monthly or weekly plan they are also 7, counted as calendar days from the first reserved day
to the last; the two conventions agree on this reservation and part company as soon as the span is not a whole
number of weeks.

**A very short reservation.** A booking reserving 5 hours on a plan other than the extended stay, monthly or
weekly plans carries up to 1 whole day, which is the fewest plan days that convention will count.
